title: Beyond Similarity Search: Knowledge Graph Metadata Enrichment for Enterprise Retrieval-Augmented Generation
abstract: arXiv:2610.37728v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: A key challenge of RAG systems is retrieving information from enterprise documents created by multiple teams over time, where it is not possible to enrich the information using the latest information and metadata available outside the scope of organizational documentation responsibility. We investigated whether using a knowledge graph to store metadata and frequently changing information would improve upon knowledge retrieval over similarity search over embeddings. To perform the experiment, we created a snapshot of the SEC EDGAR dataset for a quarter, comprising 167,050 filings from 10,511 companies and 508,714 embedded chunks of risk-factor text. To simulate the enrichment, we created a knowledge graph of 430,257 nodes and 561,144 edges carrying an accession number on every edge. To evaluate the gain obtained via a graph-based design, we evaluated three architectures: text-to-SQL over typed columns, dense-vector RAG with HNSW cosine

translated_title: 超越相似性搜索：面向企业检索增强生成的知识图谱元数据增强
translated_abstract: RAG系统的一个关键挑战是如何从由多个团队随时间创建的企业文档中检索信息，在这种情况下，无法利用组织文档职责范围之外可用的最新信息和元数据来丰富信息内容。我们研究了使用知识图谱存储元数据和频繁变化的信息，是否能够改进基于嵌入相似性搜索的知识检索效果。为了进行该实验，我们创建了SEC EDGAR数据集一个季度的快照，包含来自10,511家公司的167,050份申报文件以及508,714个嵌入的风险因素文本块。为了模拟这种信息增强，我们构建了一个包含430,257个节点和561,144条边的知识图谱，且每条边都带有访问号。为了评估基于图的设计所获得的收益，我们评估了三种架构：基于类型化列的text-to-SQL、使用HNSW余弦的稠密向量RAG……
tldr: 该研究提出利用知识图谱存储元数据和频繁变化的信息来增强企业RAG系统，并在SEC EDGAR数据集上通过对比三种架构验证了基于图的设计相较于传统嵌入相似性搜索的优势。
en_tdlr: This study proposes using a knowledge graph to store metadata and frequently changing information to enrich enterprise RAG systems, and validates the advantage of graph-based designs over traditional embedding similarity search by comparing three architectures on the SEC EDGAR dataset.
